procedure: State: The calibrated route model and ordinary candidate table describe multiple possible internal contributors. Procedure: Fit bounded nonnegative stage contributions to overlapping-route timings. Examine residual structure; select an available additional route that separates remaining assignments, refit, and compare the implicated stage under its associated old/new deployed change with controlled reset. Limits and stopping conditions: Model misspecification, coverage, finite uncertainty and replay generalization remain limits; residual patterns are not automatic proof of a hidden mechanism.

observables: Compatible assignments, route residuals, reduction of ambiguity after the selected route and controlled old/new contribution changes.
inferential_warrant: The joint constraints localize bounded contributions; discrimination-directed route selection tests unresolved structure and the controlled revision comparison tests the associated change within the replay.
problem_decomposition: Represent hidden stages jointly, distinguish model mismatch from weak coverage, and connect only independently documented stage/change associations.
next_inquiry: Select the next route from unresolved assignments; stop additional probing at the six-test budget or when no available route separates them, then report surviving alternatives and confirmation limits.
